name: Nova IVF Fertility

name: Asian Eye Hospital
finding: Single eye hospital on Station Road, Pune; directories name ~2 doctors

name: Sum Hospital

name: Anandalok Hospital
finding: No source found giving a founding year (record 1981, Wikidata 2011)

name: MIOT International

name: Chandulal Chandrakar Memorial Hospital
